purpose: Describe resource reads, actions and state changes with typed requests and explicit results.
responsibility_boundary: Own the named reusable integration/data mechanism. Product roles/UI and operational approvals stay with consumers; transport/custody reuse managed Crowsi components where capabilities fit. Planning-only APIs must remain clearly distinguished from implemented external operations.

packages.description: Transport-neutral resource, action, revision and change contracts
Generic resource, action, revision, outcome and input-declaration contracts

steps.name: Test web contracts
steps.run:
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run typecheck
npm test

steps.name: Isolated npm configuration and fresh cache
Fixed npm and isolated empty configuration
steps.run:
for config in .npmrc .pnpmfile.cjs .pnpmfile.mjs pnpm-workspace.yaml .yarnrc .yarnrc.yml; do test ! -e "$config"; done
node --input-type=module -e 'import {readFileSync} from "node:fs"; if(JSON.parse(readFileSync("package.json")).pnpm) process.exit(1)'
: > "$NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG"
: > "$NPM_CONFIG_GLOBALCONFIG"
npm install --global npm@11.12.1 --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund

steps.name: Package metadata and real public registry dependencies
Repository tests
steps.run:
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run typecheck
npm test

steps.name: Pack reviewed files without lifecycle hooks
steps.run:
mkdir outgoing
npm pack --ignore-scripts --json --pack-destination outgoing > "$RUNNER_TEMP/pack.json"
mv "outgoing/$(node -e 'console.log(JSON.parse(require("node:fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1]))[0].filename)' "$RUNNER_TEMP/pack.json")" outgoing/package.tgz
/usr/bin/python3 -E .github/scripts/check-pack.py outgoing/package.tgz > outgoing/verification.json

steps.name: Fresh cache installed pack consumer
steps.run:
consumer=$(mktemp -d)
archive="$PWD/outgoing/package.tgz"
cp .github/scripts/consumer.mts "$consumer/test.mts"
printf '%s\n' '{"private":true,"type":"module"}' > "$consumer/package.json"
(cd "$consumer" && NPM_CONFIG_CACHE="$consumer/cache" npm install "$archive" --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --offline && node test.mts)

steps.name: Require the reviewed source
steps.run:
test "$APPROVED_SHA" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
if [ "$REGISTRY_OPERATION" = publish ]; then
  git merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD origin/main
else
  git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD
fi
rustup toolchain install 1.97 --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy
rustup override set 1.97

steps.name: Validate public package metadata
Verify independent package build
steps.run:
cargo fmt --all -- --check
cargo test --locked --all-features
cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
cargo package --locked --registry crates-io

steps.name: Require the approved tag and CI artifact
steps.run:
test "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" = "v${VERSION}"
test -n "$APPROVED_SHA256"
test "$VERIFIED_SHA256" = "$APPROVED_SHA256"
rustup toolchain install 1.97 --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy
rustup override set 1.97
cargo package --locked --registry crates-io
test "$(sha256sum target/package/*.crate | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = "$APPROVED_SHA256"
